instruction:
Using TextEdit, enter the text below exactly as shown, making sure to maintain the line breaks:
Weekend errands
- Pick up dry cleaning
- Drop off donation bags

command: osascript -e 'tell application "TextEdit" to if (count of documents) = 0 then make new document'
osascript -e 'tell application "TextEdit" to set text of document 1 to ""'

reference_command:
peekaboo app launch "TextEdit" && peekaboo type 'Weekend errands
- Pick up dry cleaning
- Drop off donation bags'

parameters.expected_content:
Weekend errands
- Pick up dry cleaning
- Drop off donation bags
